name: Moped
description: A moped or motorized bicycle: two or three wheels, a motor under 4 gross brake horsepower (3,000 W), and a top speed of 30 mph on level ground.

restrictions.rule: Two or three wheels and an automatic transmission; pedals are optional (California Vehicle Code §406)
Its motor produces less than 4 gross brake horsepower (3,000 W) (California Vehicle Code §406, as amended by SB 1167 (2026))
Can't propel it faster than 30 mph on level ground (California Vehicle Code §406)
Built for highway use: meets federal motor vehicle safety standards, with a 17-digit VIN and a safety certification label (California Vehicle Code §406, as amended by SB 1167 (2026))
Riders need a driver's license with an M1 or M2 motorcycle endorsement, so must be 16 or older
Riders must wear a motorcycle helmet
Registered with the DMV and carries a moped plate; registering it doesn't require insurance
Barred from any freeway or expressway where Caltrans or the local authority posts a prohibition
Kept off bike paths and trails unless they run beside a roadway or a local ordinance allows it
A vehicle, not property: it can be towed or impounded
